context: Tests whether the agent targets the PRD rule's stated audience: requirements that are explicit, unambiguous and free of filler jargon, with concrete testable statements rather than vague 'should' prose, and no implementation started.

checklist.name: PRD at documented path and filename
Required sections present
checklist.description: The PRD includes Introduction/Overview, Goals, User Stories, Functional Requirements, Non-Goals, Success Metrics and Open Questions.

checklist.name: Requirements concrete not vague
checklist.description: Functional requirements state exact behaviour with concrete numbers from the fixture (fifteen-minute sustained window, webhook delivery), not open-ended gestures like 'alerts when errors are high'.

checklist.name: No weasel words
checklist.description: The requirements contain none of: 'as appropriate', 'leverage', 'as needed', 'and so on', 'best-effort', without a defined fallback, 'should consider'.

checklist.name: Each requirement single-verifiable
checklist.description: Each functional requirement is a single testable statement; no requirement bundles three or more unrelated behaviours.

checklist.name: Requirements answerable by junior dev
checklist.description: The requirements avoid unexplained internal jargon; any necessary domain term is either defined inline or listed in a considerations section.

checklist.name: Non-Goals manages scope
checklist.description: Non-Goals explicitly excludes things adjacent to the feature (e.g. UI alerts, auto-remediation) per the fixture's scope answers.

checklist.name: No implementation started
checklist.description: No source code files were created or modified outside tasks/ .
